description: This file defines the SugarWidgetField class, a PHP class that extends SugarWidget and provides rendering and utility methods for handling fields in the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework. It includes methods for displaying headers, labels, list values, and managing column aliases, as well as handling sorting links and widget types.
external_files: translate() function (likely defined elsewhere in the project)

classes.name: SugarWidgetField
classes.description: A class extending SugarWidget that provides various methods for displaying field data, headers, and labels within the CRM's list view and detail views.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a layout manager.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Dynamically calls a context-specific display method based on the current context attribute.

methods.name: _get_column_alias
methods.description: Generates a truncated column alias based on the layout definition's name and table alias.

methods.name: displayDetailLabel
methods.description: Returns an empty string as default for displaying detail labels.

methods.name: displayDetail
methods.description: Returns an empty string for detail display.

methods.name: displayHeaderCellPlain
methods.description: Returns the label or translated vname for the header cell.

methods.name: displayHeaderCell
methods.description: Generates the HTML for a sortable header cell with links and optional sort arrows.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Displays a list value, primarily calling displayListPlain.

methods.name: displayListPlain
methods.description: Returns the list value as plain text or a checkbox input if widget_type is checkbox.

methods.name: _get_list_value
methods.description: Retrieves the list value for a given layout definition, based on varname or column alias.

methods.name: displayEditLabel
methods.description: Returns an empty string for edit labels.

methods.name: displayEdit
methods.description: Returns an empty string for edit fields.

methods.name: displaySearchLabel
methods.description: Returns an empty string for search labels.

methods.name: displaySearch
methods.description: Returns an empty string for search fields.

methods.name: displayInput
methods.description: Indicates not implemented for input display.

methods.name: getVardef
methods.description: Returns the vardef for the field, if available based on column_key.
